proposition: The cottagekeeper will keep guests private and handle household privacy.
quote: “The cottage makes sense—the cottagekeeper knows to keep guests private. We dine quietly. No unscheduled interviews.”

proposition: Press-telegrams will be answered from the cottage after arrival.
quote: “We’ll answer from the cottage. We dine quietly. No unscheduled interviews.”

proposition: The cottagekeeper is to refuse callers and keep the household private.
quote: "I told the cottagekeeper to keep us private," she said, in the flat, usable voice years of studio fights had practiced. "If anyone comes, he refuses them. I'll be in the hall. I won't be far."
